about: What from_onshape.py builds: the mentor's Robot assembly as Onshape shows it, minus the paths that match 'drop' (regular expressions on 'Top <1> / Sub <1> / Part <1>'). Hidden and suppressed instances are already left out. Each of 'components' becomes model_<index>.glb, posed by the logs: 'parts' are the paths that move with it, 'axis_part' the one part (among them) whose 'axis' (thinnest or longest direction, through its centre) it turns about, 'angle' what the logged angle means, 'drawn_at_deg' that angle as the CAD draws it.

components.angle: TurretSubsystem.angleDegrees(): degrees counter-clockwise from home (pointing along the nose), seen from above
components.drawn_at_note: Measured 31 Oct 2026: the hood's and its channel's big flat faces point 51.5 deg counter-clockwise from the nose, and the ball leaves on that open side, away from the tall wall (confirmed on the robot).

components.drawn_at_note: Found 31 Oct 2026 from the mates: the two arms pivot on the SWYFT servo's hub and bearing <1>, drawn stowed, leaning up and back to the 312 mm shaft. Swung 162 deg forward about +Y, the shaft reaches the tile (Z 0.5 in), where the stick's wheels rest when out.
